SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_RAGS.description: The first card you play each turn grants you a bonus for the remainder of it: +1 Strength for Attacks, +1 Dexterity for Skills, and +1 Energy otherwise.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_RAGS.flavor: 'Don't look at me like that. They still do the job.' - Shion
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_RAGS.title: Battle Rags
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_GLOVES.descriptio: Each card you play grants you a bonus for the remainder of the turn: +1 Strength for Attacks, +1 Dexterity for Skills, and +1 Energy otherwise.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_GLOVES.flavor: 'Huh... I guess it IS more comfortable.' - Shion
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_GLOVES.title: Battle Gloves
SHIONTHEBRUISER-UPGRADINATOR.description: TEST!!! Upgrades all cards at the start of the fight.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-UPGRADINATOR.flavor: If you see this, I fucked up. - the Dev
SHIONTHEBRUISER-UPGRADINATOR.title: Upgradinator
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIKES_GLOVES.descriptio: Your Strikes and Energy Attacks deal {Damage::diff()} more damage.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIKES_GLOVES.flavor: It's a bad look, but is it a worse look than the rags you started with?
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIKES_GLOVES.title: Spiked Gloves
SHIONTHEBRUISER-COMMANDER_CAP.flavor: Apparently, he keeps an entire stock of those things...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-COMMANDER_CAP.title: Commander Cap
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PURPLE_CHAOS_EMERALD.des: Shuffles an Emerald Power - Vision card into your draw pile at the start of the fight.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PURPLE_CHAOS_EMERALD.fla: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those who show acumen or great intuition.
